name: openg2p-cropsown-registry-staff-ui
description: Crop Sown Staff UI — fetch staff-ui from GitHub into .app/; deltas via overrides/.

scripts.dev: node init && bash ./scripts/materialize-staff-ui.sh && bash ./scripts/ensure-app-deps.sh && npm run dev --prefix .app
scripts.build: node init && bash ./scripts/materialize-staff-ui.sh && bash ./scripts/ensure-app-deps.sh && npm run build --prefix .app
scripts.start: node init && bash ./scripts/materialize-staff-ui.sh && bash ./scripts/ensure-app-deps.sh && npm run start --prefix .app
